extracted.name: Mushroom Cookies
extracted.description: It's delicious and soft to bite. People will curious about this recipe. If there's a Mushroom or what then they encourage to tray if how is the taste
ingredient_lines: 1 cup powdered sugar (I used the measuring cup)
instruction_lines: Put the softened margarine, powdered sugar and egg at room temperature into the kneading bowl and beat it well with a mixer.
Let's add 400 grams of starch, vanilla and baking powder on it and mix it by hand. It will have a consistency that sticks to the hand.
Let's add flour in a controlled until it gets a soft consistency that does not stick to the hands. I used about 390 grams flour.

Let's take some large pieces of walnuts from the soft dough and roll them. Let's arrange them on a baking tray with baking sheets. Let's put cocoa in a separate bowl. Let's dip the mouth of the soda bottle in cocoa and press it on the cookies.
Let's bake it in a preheated 180 degree oven so that it stays white for 15 minutes. With these measurements, 25 cookies are obtained. Bon appetit
